environment.working_tree_note: Includes the earlier SecurityConfig ERROR-dispatch fix; no performance changes to application code.
environment.database_storage: Disposable Docker PostgreSQL on tmpfs, local loopback

environment.logging: Explicitly set existing loggers to WARN before measurement
environment.external_services: Mail transport, Storage, Vision, Embedding and MerchEmbedding mocked; real keyword fallback and durable outbox DB writes.
environment.pool_note: docker test profile: maximum 5, minimum 1. Deployed defaults can differ.
environment.load_note: Closed-loop 200 requests per case, same principal for private endpoints. Not a sustained production capacity test.
environment.statement_note: Hibernate prepareStatement counter only. Does not include JdbcTemplate SQL, and can include scheduled SSE authorization reads.
environment.load_sql_note: SQL counting disabled in load sweep; hibernate_statements_mean=0 is a placeholder, not a claim of zero SQL.
